name: Reports To Administrator
description: A GuardDuty detector or Security Hub hub reports to its administrator account (detector / hub -> account): Administrator.AccountId from guardduty:GetAdministratorAccount or securityhub:GetAdministratorAccount, emitted only when that account is not the detector's or hub's own. A reference, not containment; last seen: DisassociateFromAdministratorAccount ends it while the source lives.
